items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen2.5-Max
items.summary: Qwen2.5-Max is a large MoE model pretrained on over 20 trillion tokens, offered through the Alibaba Cloud API and Qwen Chat without open weights. Alibaba claims it outperforms DeepSeek-V3 on Arena-Hard, LiveBench, LiveCodeBench and GPQA-Diamond.
